summary: First backend-only test run for CYNAIAH. Wrote comprehensive pytest suite (33 tests) covering system endpoints, auth (login/register/me/duplicate/invalid role/protected), dashboard summary, projects CRUD + filters + cascade delete, scripts CRUD + version increment, sync studio music (seeded + synthesized default) and cues, rights, learning (6 courses, enrollments + idempotent enroll), portfolio, notifications, calendar auth, AI script (logline via Claude Sonnet 4.5, both unsaved and saved-to-project), and AI image (Gemini Nano Banana + file fetch via /api/generated/{filename}). All 33 tests passed (100%). Real Anthropic + Gemini providers were exercised end-to-end via emergentintegrations.

minor.issue: Accepts arbitrary dict without Pydantic model — could pass an empty body and still increment version. Consider a ScriptUpdate model with validation.
Uses full RightsRecord (with default id) as the request body; if a client sends a custom id it is trusted. Prefer a RightsCreate model with server-generated id.
Same as above — overwrites user_id/id server-side but exposes internal fields in the schema; consider PortfolioCreate.
No ownership check — any authenticated user could delete another user's cue/rights record if they know the id.
Do not verify the project belongs to the requesting user. Any authenticated user can read any project's data if they know the project_id.

action_items: (Optional) Add ownership checks on nested project resources (music/cues/rights/feedback) and on DELETE /cues, /rights.
(Optional) Introduce ScriptUpdate / RightsCreate / PortfolioCreate Pydantic models to restrict client-controlled fields.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~560 lines and mixes all domains; splitting into routers (auth, projects, scripts, sync, learning, ai) would improve maintainability.
PATCH /scripts trusts arbitrary dict payloads — validate with a Pydantic model.
Nested project GETs (music/cues/rights/feedback) skip owner check; add {'owner_id': user_id} guard via project lookup.
AI generated files served via /api/generated/{filename} are public (no auth). Acceptable for MVP but note for hardening.
generate_script returns `str(result)` if not str — could hide provider error objects; better to raise on unexpected type.
seed_data_creation: None — used idempotent /api/seed. Tests only create TEST_-prefixed transient data that is cleaned up (delete) at end of each test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Comprehensive pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_cynaiah_backend.py covers 33 cases including real AI provider calls (Claude Sonnet 4.5 + Gemini Nano Banana). BASE_URL comes from frontend/.env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. AI tests take ~10-20s each; allow ≥90s timeout. Seed is auto-run on backend startup + at login; safe to hit /api/seed repeatedly.
